claim: Orchestration layer wiring for GLM-5.2: start.sh (Mac) and start.ps1 (Windows) both source ~/.openclaw/.env.glm52 at bootstrap and print fallback status prominently after services startup. Variables: $GLM52_API_KEY, $GLM52_ENDPOINT. Both scripts check availability and log whether fallback is ACTIVE or NOT AVAILABLE. This is the entry point where all agent tasks can discover and use GLM-5.2 when needed.
conditions: orchestration start.sh start.ps1 bootstrap glm52 sourcing

decisions.notes: Session 2026-07-04: added GLM-5.2 awareness to both Mac (start.sh) and Windows (start.ps1) entry points so the fallback is available to all agents from startup.
